sections: Parties and preparation status

The owner confirms InboxEdge Agency as the contracting business, separately and individually owned/registered, and Alfred Wilson, CEO/President, as its authorized signer. The business name is recorded exactly as supplied, without an LLC or corporate suffix. Registry details, legal form and formation jurisdiction have not been independently verified; no registration number, formation state or governing law is inferred from the mailing address. Business mailing address: 8753 Dunwoody Place STE G, Atlanta, GA 30350. Email: al@inboxedgeagency.com. Telephone: +1 (844) 924-2588. The client is the legal party identified in the completed fields. This preparation copy is not executed; it creates no obligation, signature or payment authorization. The final completed agreement and scope require authorized acceptance by both parties.
Scope and document priority

Services are limited to the completed statement of work and named package. Basic is $500/month, Standard $1,000/month and Premium $2,000/month. Client-specific deliverable quantities, dates, dependencies, account identifiers, reviewers and exclusions must be completed before signing. A later mutually accepted change order governs only the terms it expressly changes; the completed scope governs deliverable detail and the services agreement governs general terms. An account-access authorization cannot expand fees or the agreed services.
Monthly billing and service start

Service is month-to-month with no setup fee, extra minimum commitment, automatic upgrade or annual obligation. The agreed monthly amount is billed in advance on the agreed service-start date and each monthly renewal. Before payment, disclose the recurring amount, renewal schedule, applicable tax treatment and cancellation path. Add only actually applicable, disclosed taxes. Separate platform charges require explicit approval. Start only after the scope is accepted, required access is available and the client is ready; any early payment must state the service and billing dates. No silent billing during an unspecified readiness period. Payment never grants account access or approves a send.
Cancellation

The client may cancel at any time without a cancellation penalty through a functioning billing portal or al@inboxedgeagency.com. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current paid period unless the parties agree an earlier end. A request received before the next charge stops future renewals. InboxEdge acknowledges within two business days; an acknowledgment delay does not invalidate a timely request. The client retains its own accounts and data.
Refunds and failed payments

Duplicate or erroneous charges are refunded. If InboxEdge cannot provide agreed service, it proposes and documents with the client a refund or credit for the undelivered portion. For voluntary mid-period cancellation after work begins, agreed service continues through period-end unless another arrangement is agreed. Disputed or partial work is reviewed against scope and delivery evidence; there is no blanket no-refund rule or waiver of applicable rights. For failed payment, notify the client and allow seven calendar days to resolve it before pausing new work. No late or collection fee is added. Communicate and record a pause; do not hold the client's accounts or data hostage.
Delivery, support and revisions

Acknowledge requests within two business days during Monday-Friday, 9 a.m.-6 p.m. America/New_York; weekends by appointment. This is a response target, not a full-resolution or 24/7 service guarantee. Within two business days of a ready start, confirm access inventory, baseline, milestone plan and approver. Target the first scoped creative proof within ten business days after required access, assets and brief are complete. Each initial flow receives its own dated build schedule; this target does not promise completion of all Standard or Premium flows in ten days. Include two consolidated revision rounds per initial creative deliverable within the accepted brief. Correct agency mistakes without consuming a creative round. New objectives, extra messages or materially changed offers require a mutually accepted change order; no automatic extra fee.
Client review and live approvals

The client supplies accurate brand facts, substantiated claims, lawful audience instructions and authorized platform invitations. One named decision-maker supplies consolidated feedback within five business days. Silence never authorizes publishing or sending. Missing access or feedback moves affected dates with notice; no automatic delay fee applies. The scope records treatment of affected recurring work rather than silently assuming rollover or forfeiture. Exact creative version, audience, offer and timing require approval evidence. Content creation, preview/test permission and live activation are separate actions. Business days mean Monday-Friday excluding holidays named in the completed service calendar.
AI assistance and third-party costs

Human review is required for AI-assisted work. Identify approved tools, tasks, data categories, usage allowance and escalation in the scope; no subscriber-list training, cross-client data access or autonomous spending is granted. Do not purchase services, activate paid SMS, buy lists or expand permissions without specific client authorization. SMS strategy does not include activation or message fees. Client platform charges are separate unless expressly included in the signed scope. InboxEdge may decline unlawful or unsupported instructions.
Confidentiality and final deliverables

Protect confidential information and disclose it only to authorized people with a service need and confidentiality duties. Information demonstrably public without breach, already lawfully known, independently developed or lawfully received without restriction is excluded. Legally required disclosure is limited to what is required, with notice when permitted. The client receives the agreed final custom creative after payment for that work, subject to third-party licenses. Agency pre-existing templates, methods and tools remain with the agency; the client may use included components as needed for the delivered work. No portfolio, testimonial, customer-list reuse or general-model training permission is implied.
Reporting and outcome limits

Provide one report per paid monthly service period within ten business days after that period ends. Identify completed work, pending approvals, next actions, actual data sources, attribution window and unavailable metrics. Strategy calls follow the selected scope. Revenue, conversions, inbox placement and platform uptime are not guaranteed. Distinguish platform-attributed sales from demonstrated incremental revenue; do not invent metrics.
Offboarding and retention

Within ten business days after service end, provide agreed deliverables and an inventory of settings, open work and access; coordinate agency-access removal. Confirm subscription cancellation separately from access revocation. Offer agreed return/export at handoff, then delete agency-controlled working copies within 30 calendar days after handoff, subject to documented instructions and necessary legal holds. Do not delete the client's source account or suppression records. Provider backups/logs follow their actual disclosed retention. Keep agreements, approvals, access records, invoices and delivery evidence for six years after service end with restricted access, excluding unrelated subscriber content; applicable obligations and documented legal holds may require a different schedule. This is a contractual business-record policy, not a claim of a universal statutory period.
Security, incidents and final legal details

Apply least privilege, individual accounts and multifactor authentication where available. Promptly escalate suspected client-data incidents to the named contact, preserve relevant evidence and share known facts and updates. Complete the actual processing/provider annex before data access. No absolute security guarantee, invented universal incident deadline, arbitration clause, liability cap, governing-law choice or waiver is created here. Any additional legal provisions require actual decisions and review before inclusion. The agency name and signer are owner-confirmed; complete the actual client identity, scope and human acceptance before final signing.

Includes Basic services, with four promotional campaigns TOTAL per paid month, not four plus Basic's one. One-time onboarding adds a four-email abandoned-cart sequence and the agreed post-purchase flow; complete the post-purchase message count and dated milestones. Recurring scope includes agreed upkeep, subject-line testing, advanced segmentation, monthly reporting and a strategy call every two weeks.
Premium - $2,000/month

Includes Standard services, plus agreed initial win-back/re-engagement and VIP flows, promotional calendar, SMS strategy, revenue-attribution reporting, weekly strategy calls and a named account manager. The client-specific scope MUST state the exact monthly campaign total, flow message counts, dates and real assigned manager before signing. No unlimited campaign volume, staffed role or message count is inferred from this draft. SMS strategy grants no paid activation.
Accepted service conditions

Month-to-month; no setup fee or extra minimum term. Monthly billing is in advance at the agreed ready start and renewal dates. Cancellation stops the next renewal when received before that charge and normally ends service at the current paid-period end. The agreement's refund, failed-payment and offboarding provisions apply. The first creative proof target is ten business days after complete access/assets/brief; confirm each initial flow's build schedule separately. Two consolidated revision rounds per initial creative deliverable are included, with agency-error correction outside that count. Client feedback is requested within five business days; silence is never live-send approval.
Evidence and acceptance

Each deliverable records its version, proof, factual claims, link/rendering checks, audience/suppression checks where relevant, reviewer decision and implementation evidence. The scope identifies measurable acceptance criteria and any client-specific dependencies. A draft, test message or provider response is not customer approval of a live launch. Identify what happens to recurring work affected by missing access or delayed approval; do not silently assume forfeiture or rollover.
Costs, exclusions and changes

Platform subscriptions, sending fees, paid SMS, media spend, list acquisition, legal advice and out-of-scope work are excluded unless specifically priced and accepted. No new spend, wider access or extra fee without an agreed change order. A client's own account remains theirs. Separate authorizations govern live sending and account changes.
Reporting

Deliver the monthly report within ten business days after the paid period ends. Agree baseline, source of truth, metric definitions and attribution window. Separate completed actions from recommendations and pending approvals; label unavailable data and test traffic. Do not equate attributed sales with proven incremental revenue.
Owner-only ONE arrangement

The separately approved owner arrangement is InboxEdge Basic at $1 EVERY MONTH for the approved owner customer al@inboxedgeagency.com, renewing monthly until cancelled. ONE is not a public discount or first-month-only offer, and it changes no other customer's recurring price. This preparation page issues no code, verifies no payment and grants no access or marketing permission. An ordinary client scope uses the published package price unless a separate specific exception is accepted.

The client may revoke its platform permissions. Record the revocation and notify the agency through the monitored contact so work can be safely paused or reassigned.
